## Risk Narrative
**CONFIDENTIAL**

As a Senior Security Consultant, I am pleased to present the key findings from our recent engagement with [Client Name]. Our analysis has revealed that the client's system presents a relatively low-risk profile, with no critical or high-severity vulnerabilities identified. The absence of any critical or high-severity findings is a testament to the organization's commitment to security and its ability to maintain a robust posture.

However, our investigation did uncover some areas for improvement. Specifically, we detected a hardcoded secret in JavaScript code, which could potentially be exploited by an attacker. Additionally, our Web Application Firewall (WAF) detection revealed that the client's system is not adequately protected against common web-based attacks. Furthermore, our analysis identified a Sentry instance, which may require additional configuration to ensure proper security and monitoring. While these findings are not critical in nature, they do warrant attention and remediation to further strengthen the organization's overall security posture.

aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">Is Syfe safe and regulated by MAS?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Yes, Syfe is a safe and regulated digital wealth manager in Singapore. It holds a Capital Markets Services (CMS) license issued by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), which means it operates under strict regulatory oversight. Client funds are kept in segregated accounts with Tier-1 banks such as HSBC and DBS, ensuring your investments remain separate from Syfe\u2019s own assets. This structure provides an additional layer of protection and transparency for investors who prioritise trust and regulatory compliance.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">How can I invest my SRS funds with Syfe?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>You can invest your Supplementary Retirement Scheme (SRS) funds with Syfe by opening an SRS investment account and selecting a diversified portfolio aligned with your retirement goals. Investing your SRS balance allows you to go beyond the base 0.05% bank rate and potentially achieve long-term wealth growth while continuing to enjoy tax relief benefits. Syfe provides professionally managed portfolios designed to help maximise SRS returns through disciplined asset allocation and automatic rebalancing.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">What are the Syfe management fees?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Syfe offers transparent, low-cost investing through a simple all-inclusive management fee structure. For managed portfolios, there are no brokerage commissions, no entry fees, and no exit fees; you only pay a single management fee that covers portfolio management, rebalancing, and account services. This pricing model makes Syfe one of the most cost-efficient investment platforms in Singapore for investors seeking long-term value and predictable costs.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">Can I earn high interest on my savings with Syfe Cash+?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Syfe Cash+ is designed as a high-yield savings account alternative for individuals who want potentially higher returns than traditional savings accounts. It offers projected returns with no lock-in period, allowing you to withdraw funds anytime while still earning daily accrual of interest. This makes Syfe Cash+ suitable for short- to medium-term savings goals, emergency funds, or idle cash that you want working harder.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">How do I buy US stocks and ETFs in Singapore with Syfe?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>You can buy US stocks and ETFs in Singapore through Syfe Brokerage, which provides access to major exchanges such as the NYSE, NASDAQ, and LSE. The platform supports fractional shares, allowing you to invest in high-priced stocks with smaller amounts of capital. With zero-commission trades on US equities, Syfe is widely considered one of the cheapest ways to buy US stocks in Singapore, especially for investors who want a simple and cost-efficient brokerage experience.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">What is the best Digital Wealth Manager platform in Singapore for beginners?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>For beginners, the best digital wealth manager platform in Singapore is one that combines simplicity, affordability, and automation; and Syfe is designed with these features in mind. There is no minimum investment requirement, making it accessible to new investors who want to start small. The intuitive app interface and automated portfolio rebalancing help maintain your target allocation without manual intervention, reducing the complexity of managing investments.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div SECTION INTERACTION\n    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n      // Only track clicks on links and buttons\n      const clickedElement = e.target.closest('a, button');\n      if (!clickedElement) return;\n\n      // Skip if in header, nav, or footer\n      if (clickedElement.closest('nav, footer, [data-navbar]', '#navbar')) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Skip login/signup/download buttons (already tracked separately)\n      if (clickedElement.matches('a[href*=\"/login\"], #login-btn, a[href*=\"/create-account\"], [data-action=\"login\"], [data-action=\"signup\"], [data-action=\"download-app\"]')) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Find the section container\n      const sectionContainer = clickedElement.closest('section, .section, [class*=\"section\"]');\n      if (!sectionContainer) return;\n\n      // Get section name - priority order\n      let sectionName = '';\n\n      // 1. Try H2/H3 first\n      const sectionHeading = sectionContainer.querySelector('h2, h3');\n      if (sectionHeading && sectionHeading.innerText.trim() !== \"\") {\n        sectionName = sectionHeading.innerText.trim();\n      }\n      // 2. Try ID\n      else if (sectionContainer.id) {\n        sectionName = sectionContainer.id;\n      }\n      // 3. Try section class\n      else {\n        const classList = sectionContainer.className.split(' ');\n        const sectionClass = classList.find(cls => cls.includes('section'));\n        if (sectionClass) {\n          sectionName = sectionClass;\n        }\n        // 4. Fallback\n        else {\n          sectionName = 'Unnamed Section';\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Get sub-section name\n      let subSectionName = '';\n      const parentCard = clickedElement.closest('[class*=\"card\"], [class*=\"item\"], [class*=\"article\"], .w-dyn-item');\n\n      if (parentCard) {\n        const subHeading = parentCard.querySelector('h3, h4, h5, [class*=\"title\"], [class*=\"heading\"]');\n        if (subHeading) {\n          subSectionName = subHeading.innerText.trim();\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Get click element text\n      const clickElementText = clickedElement.innerText.trim() || \n            clickedElement.getAttribute('aria-label') || \n            'Unknown';\n\n      const eventData = {\n        'event': 'section_interaction',\n        'click_element': clickElementText,\n        'section_name': sectionName,\n        'sub-section_name': subSectionName,\n        'source_page_url': window.location.pathname,\n        'destination_page_url': clickedElement.getAttribute('href') || ''\n      };\n\n      pushToDataLayer(eventData);\n    }, true);\n\n\n    // 5. aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">Is Syfe safe and regulated by MAS?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Yes, Syfe is a safe and regulated digital wealth manager in Singapore. It holds a Capital Markets Services (CMS) license issued by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), which means it operates under strict regulatory oversight. Client funds are kept in segregated accounts with Tier-1 banks such as HSBC and DBS, ensuring your investments remain separate from Syfe\u2019s own assets. This structure provides an additional layer of protection and transparency for investors who prioritise trust and regulatory compliance.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">How can I invest my SRS funds with Syfe?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>You can invest your Supplementary Retirement Scheme (SRS) funds with Syfe by opening an SRS investment account and selecting a diversified portfolio aligned with your retirement goals. Investing your SRS balance allows you to go beyond the base 0.05% bank rate and potentially achieve long-term wealth growth while continuing to enjoy tax relief benefits. Syfe provides professionally managed portfolios designed to help maximise SRS returns through disciplined asset allocation and automatic rebalancing.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">What are the Syfe management fees?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Syfe offers transparent, low-cost investing through a simple all-inclusive management fee structure. For managed portfolios, there are no brokerage commissions, no entry fees, and no exit fees; you only pay a single management fee that covers portfolio management, rebalancing, and account services. This pricing model makes Syfe one of the most cost-efficient investment platforms in Singapore for investors seeking long-term value and predictable costs.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">Can I earn high interest on my savings with Syfe Cash+?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Syfe Cash+ is designed as a high-yield savings account alternative for individuals who want potentially higher returns than traditional savings accounts. It offers projected returns with no lock-in period, allowing you to withdraw funds anytime while still earning daily accrual of interest. This makes Syfe Cash+ suitable for short- to medium-term savings goals, emergency funds, or idle cash that you want working harder.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">How do I buy US stocks and ETFs in Singapore with Syfe?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>You can buy US stocks and ETFs in Singapore through Syfe Brokerage, which provides access to major exchanges such as the NYSE, NASDAQ, and LSE. The platform supports fractional shares, allowing you to invest in high-priced stocks with smaller amounts of capital. With zero-commission trades on US equities, Syfe is widely considered one of the cheapest ways to buy US stocks in Singapore, especially for investors who want a simple and cost-efficient brokerage experience.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">What is the best Digital Wealth Manager platform in Singapore for beginners?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>For beginners, the best digital wealth manager platform in Singapore is one that combines simplicity, affordability, and automation; and Syfe is designed with these features in mind. There is no minimum investment requirement, making it accessible to new investors who want to start small. The intuitive app interface and automated portfolio rebalancing help maintain your target allocation without manual intervention, reducing the complexity of managing investments.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div SECTION INTERACTION\n    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n      // Only track clicks on links and buttons\n      const clickedElement = e.target.closest('a, button');\n      if (!clickedElement) return;\n\n      // Skip if in header, nav, or footer\n      if (clickedElement.closest('nav, footer, [data-navbar]', '#navbar')) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Skip login/signup/download buttons (already tracked separately)\n      if (clickedElement.matches('a[href*=\"/login\"], #login-btn, a[href*=\"/create-account\"], [data-action=\"login\"], [data-action=\"signup\"], [data-action=\"download-app\"]')) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Find the section container\n      const sectionContainer = clickedElement.closest('section, .section, [class*=\"section\"]');\n      if (!sectionContainer) return;\n\n      // Get section name - priority order\n      let sectionName = '';\n\n      // 1. Try H2/H3 first\n      const sectionHeading = sectionContainer.querySelector('h2, h3');\n      if (sectionHeading && sectionHeading.innerText.trim() !== \"\") {\n        sectionName = sectionHeading.innerText.trim();\n      }\n      // 2. Try ID\n      else if (sectionContainer.id) {\n        sectionName = sectionContainer.id;\n      }\n      // 3. Try section class\n      else {\n        const classList = sectionContainer.className.split(' ');\n        const sectionClass = classList.find(cls => cls.includes('section'));\n        if (sectionClass) {\n          sectionName = sectionClass;\n        }\n        // 4. Fallback\n        else {\n          sectionName = 'Unnamed Section';\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Get sub-section name\n      let subSectionName = '';\n      const parentCard = clickedElement.closest('[class*=\"card\"], [class*=\"item\"], [class*=\"article\"], .w-dyn-item');\n\n      if (parentCard) {\n        const subHeading = parentCard.querySelector('h3, h4, h5, [class*=\"title\"], [class*=\"heading\"]');\n        if (subHeading) {\n          subSectionName = subHeading.innerText.trim();\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Get click element text\n      const clickElementText = clickedElement.innerText.trim() || \n            clickedElement.getAttribute('aria-label') || \n            'Unknown';\n\n      const eventData = {\n        'event': 'section_interaction',\n        'click_element': clickElementText,\n        'section_name': sectionName,\n        'sub-section_name': subSectionName,\n        'source_page_url': window.location.pathname,\n        'destination_page_url': clickedElement.getAttribute('href') || ''\n      };\n\n      pushToDataLayer(eventData);\n    }, true);\n\n\n    // 5. aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">Is Syfe safe and regulated by MAS?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Yes, Syfe is a safe and regulated digital wealth manager in Singapore. It holds a Capital Markets Services (CMS) license issued by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), which means it operates under strict regulatory oversight. Client funds are kept in segregated accounts with Tier-1 banks such as HSBC and DBS, ensuring your investments remain separate from Syfe\u2019s own assets. This structure provides an additional layer of protection and transparency for investors who prioritise trust and regulatory compliance.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">How can I invest my SRS funds with Syfe?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>You can invest your Supplementary Retirement Scheme (SRS) funds with Syfe by opening an SRS investment account and selecting a diversified portfolio aligned with your retirement goals. Investing your SRS balance allows you to go beyond the base 0.05% bank rate and potentially achieve long-term wealth growth while continuing to enjoy tax relief benefits. Syfe provides professionally managed portfolios designed to help maximise SRS returns through disciplined asset allocation and automatic rebalancing.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">What are the Syfe management fees?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Syfe offers transparent, low-cost investing through a simple all-inclusive management fee structure. For managed portfolios, there are no brokerage commissions, no entry fees, and no exit fees; you only pay a single management fee that covers portfolio management, rebalancing, and account services. This pricing model makes Syfe one of the most cost-efficient investment platforms in Singapore for investors seeking long-term value and predictable costs.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">Can I earn high interest on my savings with Syfe Cash+?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Syfe Cash+ is designed as a high-yield savings account alternative for individuals who want potentially higher returns than traditional savings accounts. It offers projected returns with no lock-in period, allowing you to withdraw funds anytime while still earning daily accrual of interest. This makes Syfe Cash+ suitable for short- to medium-term savings goals, emergency funds, or idle cash that you want working harder.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">How do I buy US stocks and ETFs in Singapore with Syfe?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>You can buy US stocks and ETFs in Singapore through Syfe Brokerage, which provides access to major exchanges such as the NYSE, NASDAQ, and LSE. The platform supports fractional shares, allowing you to invest in high-priced stocks with smaller amounts of capital. With zero-commission trades on US equities, Syfe is widely considered one of the cheapest ways to buy US stocks in Singapore, especially for investors who want a simple and cost-efficient brokerage experience.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">What is the best Digital Wealth Manager platform in Singapore for beginners?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>For beginners, the best digital wealth manager platform in Singapore is one that combines simplicity, affordability, and automation; and Syfe is designed with these features in mind. There is no minimum investment requirement, making it accessible to new investors who want to start small. The intuitive app interface and automated portfolio rebalancing help maintain your target allocation without manual intervention, reducing the complexity of managing investments.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div -->\n\n<!-- Event Parameters for GA4 -->\n<script>\n  // Initialize dataLayer\n  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];\n\n  function pushToDataLayer(eventData) {\n    //console.log('\ud83d\udd35 GA4 Event Fired:', eventData);\n    //console.table(eventData);\n    window.dataLayer.push(eventData);\n  }\n\n  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {\n\n    // 1. HEADER NAVIGATION INTERACTION\n    const headerLinks = document.querySelectorAll('[data-navbar] a');\n    headerLinks.forEach(link => {\n      link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n\n        // Skip if this is a login button\n        if (this.getAttribute('href')?.includes('/login') || this.id === 'login-btn') {\n          return; // Don't fire header event for login buttons\n        }\n\n        const eventData = {\n          'event': 'header_navigation_interaction',\n          'click_element': this.textContent.trim(),\n          'header_level': this.getAttribute('data-header-level') || '2',\n          'header_section': this.getAttribute('data-header-section') || '',\n          'header_sub-section': this.getAttribute('data-header-subsection') || '',\n          'source_page_url': window.location.pathname,\n          'destination_page_url': this.getAttribute('href') || ''\n        };\n        pushToDataLayer(eventData);\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 2. LOGIN INITIATION\n    const loginButtons = document.querySelectorAll('a[href*=\"/login\"], #login-btn');\n    loginButtons.forEach(button => {\n      button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n        const eventData = {\n          'event': 'login_initiation',\n          'source_page_url': window.location.pathname,\n          'destination_page_url': this.getAttribute('href') || '/login'\n        };\n        pushToDataLayer(eventData);\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 3. LOGIN SUCCESS (add this code on your login success page or callback)\n    // This should be triggered after successful authentication\n    function trackLoginSuccess(email) {\n      // Hash the email using SHA-256\n      crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(email))\n        .then(hashBuffer => {\n        const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));\n        const hashed_email = hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');\n\n        window.dataLayer.push({\n          event: 'login_success',\n          hashed_email: hashed_email,\n          source_page_url: window.location.pathname,\n          destination_page_url: '/dashboard/account-setup/personal-info'\n        });\n      });\n    }\n\n\n    // 4. SECTION INTERACTION\n    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n      // Only track clicks on links and buttons\n      const clickedElement = e.target.closest('a, button');\n      if (!clickedElement) return;\n\n      // Skip if in header, nav, or footer\n      if (clickedElement.closest('nav, footer, [data-navbar]', '#navbar')) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Skip login/signup/download buttons (already tracked separately)\n      if (clickedElement.matches('a[href*=\"/login\"], #login-btn, a[href*=\"/create-account\"], [data-action=\"login\"], [data-action=\"signup\"], [data-action=\"download-app\"]')) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Find the section container\n      const sectionContainer = clickedElement.closest('section, .section, [class*=\"section\"]');\n      if (!sectionContainer) return;\n\n      // Get section name - priority order\n      let sectionName = '';\n\n      // 1. Try H2/H3 first\n      const sectionHeading = sectionContainer.querySelector('h2, h3');\n      if (sectionHeading && sectionHeading.innerText.trim() !== \"\") {\n        sectionName = sectionHeading.innerText.trim();\n      }\n      // 2. Try ID\n      else if (sectionContainer.id) {\n        sectionName = sectionContainer.id;\n      }\n      // 3. aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">Is Syfe safe and regulated by MAS?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Yes, Syfe is a safe and regulated digital wealth manager in Singapore. It holds a Capital Markets Services (CMS) license issued by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), which means it operates under strict regulatory oversight. Client funds are kept in segregated accounts with Tier-1 banks such as HSBC and DBS, ensuring your investments remain separate from Syfe\u2019s own assets. This structure provides an additional layer of protection and transparency for investors who prioritise trust and regulatory compliance.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">How can I invest my SRS funds with Syfe?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>You can invest your Supplementary Retirement Scheme (SRS) funds with Syfe by opening an SRS investment account and selecting a diversified portfolio aligned with your retirement goals. Investing your SRS balance allows you to go beyond the base 0.05% bank rate and potentially achieve long-term wealth growth while continuing to enjoy tax relief benefits. Syfe provides professionally managed portfolios designed to help maximise SRS returns through disciplined asset allocation and automatic rebalancing.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">What are the Syfe management fees?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Syfe offers transparent, low-cost investing through a simple all-inclusive management fee structure. For managed portfolios, there are no brokerage commissions, no entry fees, and no exit fees; you only pay a single management fee that covers portfolio management, rebalancing, and account services. This pricing model makes Syfe one of the most cost-efficient investment platforms in Singapore for investors seeking long-term value and predictable costs.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">Can I earn high interest on my savings with Syfe Cash+?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Syfe Cash+ is designed as a high-yield savings account alternative for individuals who want potentially higher returns than traditional savings accounts. It offers projected returns with no lock-in period, allowing you to withdraw funds anytime while still earning daily accrual of interest. This makes Syfe Cash+ suitable for short- to medium-term savings goals, emergency funds, or idle cash that you want working harder.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">How do I buy US stocks and ETFs in Singapore with Syfe?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>You can buy US stocks and ETFs in Singapore through Syfe Brokerage, which provides access to major exchanges such as the NYSE, NASDAQ, and LSE. The platform supports fractional shares, allowing you to invest in high-priced stocks with smaller amounts of capital. With zero-commission trades on US equities, Syfe is widely considered one of the cheapest ways to buy US stocks in Singapore, especially for investors who want a simple and cost-efficient brokerage experience.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">What is the best Digital Wealth Manager platform in Singapore for beginners?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>For beginners, the best digital wealth manager platform in Singapore is one that combines simplicity, affordability, and automation; and Syfe is designed with these features in mind. There is no minimum investment requirement, making it accessible to new investors who want to start small. The intuitive app interface and automated portfolio rebalancing help maintain your target allocation without manual intervention, reducing the complexity of managing investments.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div -->\n\n<!-- Event Parameters for GA4 -->\n<script>\n  // Initialize dataLayer\n  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];\n\n  function pushToDataLayer(eventData) {\n    //console.log('\ud83d\udd35 GA4 Event Fired:', eventData);\n    //console.table(eventData);\n    window.dataLayer.push(eventData);\n  }\n\n  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {\n\n    // 1. HEADER NAVIGATION INTERACTION\n    const headerLinks = document.querySelectorAll('[data-navbar] a');\n    headerLinks.forEach(link => {\n      link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n\n        // Skip if this is a login button\n        if (this.getAttribute('href')?.includes('/login') || this.id === 'login-btn') {\n          return; // Don't fire header event for login buttons\n        }\n\n        const eventData = {\n          'event': 'header_navigation_interaction',\n          'click_element': this.textContent.trim(),\n          'header_level': this.getAttribute('data-header-level') || '2',\n          'header_section': this.getAttribute('data-header-section') || '',\n          'header_sub-section': this.getAttribute('data-header-subsection') || '',\n          'source_page_url': window.location.pathname,\n          'destination_page_url': this.getAttribute('href') || ''\n        };\n        pushToDataLayer(eventData);\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 2. LOGIN INITIATION\n    const loginButtons = document.querySelectorAll('a[href*=\"/login\"], #login-btn');\n    loginButtons.forEach(button => {\n      button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n        const eventData = {\n          'event': 'login_initiation',\n          'source_page_url': window.location.pathname,\n          'destination_page_url': this.getAttribute('href') || '/login'\n        };\n        pushToDataLayer(eventData);\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 3. LOGIN SUCCESS (add this code on your login success page or callback)\n    // This should be triggered after successful authentication\n    function trackLoginSuccess(email) {\n      // Hash the email using SHA-256\n      crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(email))\n        .then(hashBuffer => {\n        const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));\n        const hashed_email = hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');\n\n        window.dataLayer.push({\n          event: 'login_success',\n          hashed_email: hashed_email,\n          source_page_url: window.location.pathname,\n          destination_page_url: '/dashboard/account-setup/personal-info'\n        });\n      });\n    }\n\n\n    // 4. SECTION INTERACTION\n    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n      // Only track clicks on links and buttons\n      const clickedElement = e.target.closest('a, button');\n      if (!clickedElement) return;\n\n      // Skip if in header, nav, or footer\n      if (clickedElement.closest('nav, footer, [data-navbar]', '#navbar')) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Skip login/signup/download buttons (already tracked separately)\n      if (clickedElement.matches('a[href*=\"/login\"], #login-btn, a[href*=\"/create-account\"], [data-action=\"login\"], [data-action=\"signup\"], [data-action=\"download-app\"]')) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Find the section container\n      const sectionContainer = clickedElement.closest('section, .section, [class*=\"section\"]');\n      if (!sectionContainer) return;\n\n      // Get section name - priority order\n      let sectionName = '';\n\n      // 1. Try H2/H3 first\n      const sectionHeading = sectionContainer.querySelector('h2, h3');\n      if (sectionHeading && sectionHeading.innerText.trim() !== \"\") {\n        sectionName = sectionHeading.innerText.trim();\n      }\n      // 2. Try ID\n      else if (sectionContainer.id) {\n        sectionName = sectionContainer.id;\n      }\n      // 3. Try section class\n      else {\n        const classList = sectionContainer.className.split(' ');\n        const sectionClass = classList.find(cls => cls.includes('section'));\n        if (sectionClass) {\n          sectionName = sectionClass;\n        }\n        // 4. aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">Is Syfe safe and regulated by MAS?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Yes, Syfe is a safe and regulated digital wealth manager in Singapore. It holds a Capital Markets Services (CMS) license issued by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), which means it operates under strict regulatory oversight. Client funds are kept in segregated accounts with Tier-1 banks such as HSBC and DBS, ensuring your investments remain separate from Syfe\u2019s own assets. This structure provides an additional layer of protection and transparency for investors who prioritise trust and regulatory compliance.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">How can I invest my SRS funds with Syfe?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>You can invest your Supplementary Retirement Scheme (SRS) funds with Syfe by opening an SRS investment account and selecting a diversified portfolio aligned with your retirement goals. Investing your SRS balance allows you to go beyond the base 0.05% bank rate and potentially achieve long-term wealth growth while continuing to enjoy tax relief benefits. Syfe provides professionally managed portfolios designed to help maximise SRS returns through disciplined asset allocation and automatic rebalancing.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">What are the Syfe management fees?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Syfe offers transparent, low-cost investing through a simple all-inclusive management fee structure. For managed portfolios, there are no brokerage commissions, no entry fees, and no exit fees; you only pay a single management fee that covers portfolio management, rebalancing, and account services. This pricing model makes Syfe one of the most cost-efficient investment platforms in Singapore for investors seeking long-term value and predictable costs.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">Can I earn high interest on my savings with Syfe Cash+?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Syfe Cash+ is designed as a high-yield savings account alternative for individuals who want potentially higher returns than traditional savings accounts. It offers projected returns with no lock-in period, allowing you to withdraw funds anytime while still earning daily accrual of interest. This makes Syfe Cash+ suitable for short- to medium-term savings goals, emergency funds, or idle cash that you want working harder.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">How do I buy US stocks and ETFs in Singapore with Syfe?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>You can buy US stocks and ETFs in Singapore through Syfe Brokerage, which provides access to major exchanges such as the NYSE, NASDAQ, and LSE. The platform supports fractional shares, allowing you to invest in high-priced stocks with smaller amounts of capital. With zero-commission trades on US equities, Syfe is widely considered one of the cheapest ways to buy US stocks in Singapore, especially for investors who want a simple and cost-efficient brokerage experience.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">What is the best Digital Wealth Manager platform in Singapore for beginners?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>For beginners, the best digital wealth manager platform in Singapore is one that combines simplicity, affordability, and automation; and Syfe is designed with these features in mind. There is no minimum investment requirement, making it accessible to new investors who want to start small. The intuitive app interface and automated portfolio rebalancing help maintain your target allocation without manual intervention, reducing the complexity of managing investments.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div -->\n\n<!-- Event Parameters for GA4 -->\n<script>\n  // Initialize dataLayer\n  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];\n\n  function pushToDataLayer(eventData) {\n    //console.log('\ud83d\udd35 GA4 Event Fired:', eventData);\n    //console.table(eventData);\n    window.dataLayer.push(eventData);\n  }\n\n  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {\n\n    // 1. HEADER NAVIGATION INTERACTION\n    const headerLinks = document.querySelectorAll('[data-navbar] a');\n    headerLinks.forEach(link => {\n      link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n\n        // Skip if this is a login button\n        if (this.getAttribute('href')?.includes('/login') || this.id === 'login-btn') {\n          return; // Don't fire header event for login buttons\n        }\n\n        const eventData = {\n          'event': 'header_navigation_interaction',\n          'click_element': this.textContent.trim(),\n          'header_level': this.getAttribute('data-header-level') || '2',\n          'header_section': this.getAttribute('data-header-section') || '',\n          'header_sub-section': this.getAttribute('data-header-subsection') || '',\n          'source_page_url': window.location.pathname,\n          'destination_page_url': this.getAttribute('href') || ''\n        };\n        pushToDataLayer(eventData);\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 2. LOGIN INITIATION\n    const loginButtons = document.querySelectorAll('a[href*=\"/login\"], #login-btn');\n    loginButtons.forEach(button => {\n      button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n        const eventData = {\n          'event': 'login_initiation',\n          'source_page_url': window.location.pathname,\n          'destination_page_url': this.getAttribute('href') || '/login'\n        };\n        pushToDataLayer(eventData);\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 3. LOGIN SUCCESS (add this code on your login success page or callback)\n    // This should be triggered after successful authentication\n    function trackLoginSuccess(email) {\n      // Hash the email using SHA-256\n      crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(email))\n        .then(hashBuffer => {\n        const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));\n        const hashed_email = hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');\n\n        window.dataLayer.push({\n          event: 'login_success',\n          hashed_email: hashed_email,\n          source_page_url: window.location.pathname,\n          destination_page_url: '/dashboard/account-setup/personal-info'\n        });\n      });\n    }\n\n\n    // 4. SECTION INTERACTION\n    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n      // Only track clicks on links and buttons\n      const clickedElement = e.target.closest('a, button');\n      if (!clickedElement) return;\n\n      // Skip if in header, nav, or footer\n      if (clickedElement.closest('nav, footer, [data-navbar]', '#navbar')) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Skip login/signup/download buttons (already tracked separately)\n      if (clickedElement.matches('a[href*=\"/login\"], #login-btn, a[href*=\"/create-account\"], [data-action=\"login\"], [data-action=\"signup\"], [data-action=\"download-app\"]')) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Find the section container\n      const sectionContainer = clickedElement.closest('section, .section, [class*=\"section\"]');\n      if (!sectionContainer) return;\n\n      // Get section name - priority order\n      let sectionName = '';\n\n      // 1. Try H2/H3 first\n      const sectionHeading = sectionContainer.querySelector('h2, h3');\n      if (sectionHeading && sectionHeading.innerText.trim() !== \"\") {\n        sectionName = sectionHeading.innerText.trim();\n      }\n      // 2. Try ID\n      else if (sectionContainer.id) {\n        sectionName = sectionContainer.id;\n      }\n      // 3. Try section class\n      else {\n        const classList = sectionContainer.className.split(' ');\n        const sectionClass = classList.find(cls => cls.includes('section'));\n        if (sectionClass) {\n          sectionName = sectionClass;\n        }\n        // 4. Fallback\n        else {\n          sectionName = 'Unnamed Section';\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Get sub-section name\n      let subSectionName = '';\n      const parentCard = clickedElement.closest('[class*=\"card\"], [class*=\"item\"], [class*=\"article\"], .w-dyn-item');\n\n      if (parentCard) {\n        const subHeading = parentCard.querySelector('h3, h4, h5, [class*=\"title\"], [class*=\"heading\"]');\n        if (subHeading) {\n          subSectionName = subHeading.innerText.trim();\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Get click element text\n      const clickElementText = clickedElement.innerText.trim() || \n            clickedElement.getAttribute('aria-label') || \n            'Unknown';\n\n      const eventData = {\n        'event': 'section_interaction',\n        'click_element': clickElementText,\n        'section_name': sectionName,\n        'sub-section_name': subSectionName,\n        'source_page_url': window.location.pathname,\n        'destination_page_url': clickedElement.getAttribute('href') || ''\n      };\n\n      pushToDataLayer(eventData);\n    }, true);\n\n\n    // 5. FOOTER NAVIGATION INTERACTION\n    const footerLinks = document.querySelectorAll('footer a');\n    footerLinks.forEach(link => {\n      link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n        const eventData = {\n          'event': 'footer_navigation_interaction',\n          'click_element': this.textContent.trim(),\n          'footer_section': this.getAttribute('data-footer-section') || '',\n          'footer_sub-section': this.getAttribute('data-footer-subsection') || '',\n          'footer_sub-section2': this.getAttribute('data-footer-subsection2') || '',\n          'source_page_url': window.location.pathname,\n          'destination_page_url': this.getAttribute('href') || ''\n        };\n        pushToDataLayer(eventData);\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 6. fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Yes, Syfe is a safe and regulated digital wealth manager in Singapore. It holds a Capital Markets Services (CMS) license issued by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), which means it operates under strict regulatory oversight. Client funds are kept in segregated accounts with Tier-1 banks such as HSBC and DBS, ensuring your investments remain separate from Syfe\u2019s own assets. This structure provides an additional layer of protection and transparency for investors who prioritise trust and regulatory compliance.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">How can I invest my SRS funds with Syfe?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>You can invest your Supplementary Retirement Scheme (SRS) funds with Syfe by opening an SRS investment account and selecting a diversified portfolio aligned with your retirement goals. Investing your SRS balance allows you to go beyond the base 0.05% bank rate and potentially achieve long-term wealth growth while continuing to enjoy tax relief benefits. Syfe provides professionally managed portfolios designed to help maximise SRS returns through disciplined asset allocation and automatic rebalancing.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">What are the Syfe management fees?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Syfe offers transparent, low-cost investing through a simple all-inclusive management fee structure. For managed portfolios, there are no brokerage commissions, no entry fees, and no exit fees; you only pay a single management fee that covers portfolio management, rebalancing, and account services. This pricing model makes Syfe one of the most cost-efficient investment platforms in Singapore for investors seeking long-term value and predictable costs.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">Can I earn high interest on my savings with Syfe Cash+?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>Syfe Cash+ is designed as a high-yield savings account alternative for individuals who want potentially higher returns than traditional savings accounts. It offers projected returns with no lock-in period, allowing you to withdraw funds anytime while still earning daily accrual of interest. This makes Syfe Cash+ suitable for short- to medium-term savings goals, emergency funds, or idle cash that you want working harder.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">How do I buy US stocks and ETFs in Singapore with Syfe?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>You can buy US stocks and ETFs in Singapore through Syfe Brokerage, which provides access to major exchanges such as the NYSE, NASDAQ, and LSE. The platform supports fractional shares, allowing you to invest in high-priced stocks with smaller amounts of capital. With zero-commission trades on US equities, Syfe is widely considered one of the cheapest ways to buy US stocks in Singapore, especially for investors who want a simple and cost-efficient brokerage experience.</p></div></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"accordion\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_item\"><div fs-accordion-element=\"trigger\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-controls=\"accordion-2-content-1\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">What is the best Digital Wealth Manager platform in Singapore for beginners?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div fs-accordion-line=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_horizontal-line\"></div></div></div><div fs-accordion-element=\"content\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-2-header-1\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_content\"><div class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_body\"><div fs-accordion-text=\"\" class=\"syfe--text-rich-text syfe--is-faq w-richtext\"><p>For beginners, the best digital wealth manager platform in Singapore is one that combines simplicity, affordability, and automation; and Syfe is designed with these features in mind. There is no minimum investment requirement, making it accessible to new investors who want to start small. The intuitive app interface and automated portfolio rebalancing help maintain your target allocation without manual intervention, reducing the complexity of managing investments.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div Try H2/H3 first\n      const sectionHeading = sectionContainer.querySelector('h2, h3');\n      if (sectionHeading && sectionHeading.innerText.trim() !== \"\") {\n        sectionName = sectionHeading.innerText.trim();\n      }\n      // 2. Try ID\n      else if (sectionContainer.id) {\n        sectionName = sectionContainer.id;\n      }\n      // 3. Try section class\n      else {\n        const classList = sectionContainer.className.split(' ');\n        const sectionClass = classList.find(cls => cls.includes('section'));\n        if (sectionClass) {\n          sectionName = sectionClass;\n        }\n        // 4. Fallback\n        else {\n          sectionName = 'Unnamed Section';\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Get sub-section name\n      let subSectionName = '';\n      const parentCard = clickedElement.closest('[class*=\"card\"], [class*=\"item\"], [class*=\"article\"], .w-dyn-item');\n\n      if (parentCard) {\n        const subHeading = parentCard.querySelector('h3, h4, h5, [class*=\"title\"], [class*=\"heading\"]');\n        if (subHeading) {\n          subSectionName = subHeading.innerText.trim();\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Get click element text\n      const clickElementText = clickedElement.innerText.trim() || \n            clickedElement.getAttribute('aria-label') || \n            'Unknown';\n\n      const eventData = {\n        'event': 'section_interaction',\n        'click_element': clickElementText,\n        'section_name': sectionName,\n        'sub-section_name': subSectionName,\n        'source_page_url': window.location.pathname,\n        'destination_page_url': clickedElement.getAttribute('href') || ''\n      };\n\n      pushToDataLayer(eventData);\n    }, true);\n\n\n    // 5. FOOTER NAVIGATION INTERACTION\n    const footerLinks = document.querySelectorAll('footer a');\n    footerLinks.forEach(link => {\n      link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n        const eventData = {\n          'event': 'footer_navigation_interaction',\n          'click_element': this.textContent.trim(),\n          'footer_section': this.getAttribute('data-footer-section') || '',\n          'footer_sub-section': this.getAttribute('data-footer-subsection') || '',\n          'footer_sub-section2': this.getAttribute('data-footer-subsection2') || '',\n          'source_page_url': window.location.pathname,\n          'destination_page_url': this.getAttribute('href') || ''\n        };\n        pushToDataLayer(eventData);\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 6. ACCOUNT OPEN\n    const signupButtons = document.querySelectorAll('a[href*=\"/create-account\"], button[data-action=\"signup\"]');\n    signupButtons.forEach(button => {\n      button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n        window.dataLayer.push({\n          event: 'account_open',\n          click_element: this.textContent.trim(),\n          hashed_email: '', // Set after email is captured\n          source_page_url: window.location.pathname,\n          destination_page_url: this.getAttribute('href') || '/create-account'\n        });\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 7. USER REGISTRATION INITIATED\n    const verifyButtons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-action=\"verify\"], button[data-track=\"registration-init\"]');\n    verifyButtons.forEach(button => {\n      button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n        window.dataLayer.push({\n          event: 'user_registration_initiated',\n          click_element: this.textContent.trim()\n        });\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 8. USER REGISTRATION SUCCESS (trigger on success page)\n    if (window.location.pathname.includes('registration-success') || document.querySelector('[data-registration-success]')) {\n      window.dataLayer.push({\n        event: 'user_registration_success'\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 9. DOWNLOAD APP\n    const downloadButtons = document.querySelectorAll('a[href*=\"/open-store\"], #download-btn');\n    downloadButtons.forEach(button => {\n      button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n        window.dataLayer.push({\n          event: 'download_app',\n          click_element: this.textContent.trim(),\n          source_page_url: window.location.pathname\n        });\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 10. SCHEDULE CALL\n    const scheduleButtons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-action=\"schedule-call\"]');\n    scheduleButtons.forEach(button => {\n      button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {\n        window.dataLayer.push({\n          event: 'schedule_call',\n          click_element: this.textContent.trim(),\n          source_page_url: window.location.pathname,\n          call_date: announcementBar.style.display = 'none';\n    }\n\n    closeAnnouncement?.addEventListener('click', function () {\n      announcementBar.style.display = 'none';\n      sessionStorage.setItem('announcementClosed', 'true');\n    });\n\n    // \u2705 Scroll behavior\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {\n      if (window.scrollY > 0) {\n        navbar.setAttribute('data-scrolled', 'true');\n      } else {\n        navbar.removeAttribute('data-scrolled');\n      }\n    });\n\n    // \u2705 Dropdown behavior\n    function document.querySelectorAll('[data-invest-link]').forEach((investLink) => {\n      const dropdownList = investLink.closest('[data-dropdown-list]');\n      if (!dropdownList) return;\n\n      investLink.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {\n        dropdownList.classList.add('hover-invest');\n      });\n\n      investLink.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {\n        dropdownList.classList.remove('hover-invest');\n      });\n    });\n\n    // \u2705 Update login button visibility\n    const updateShowButtonState = () => {\n      const loginNavButton = loginNavButton.style.display = 'block';\n      }\n    };\n\n    updateShowButtonState();\n  });\n\n  // \u2705 Keep login button synced across tabs\n  window.addEventListener('storage', () => {\n aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_header\"><div fs-accordion-question=\"\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_label\">Is Syfe safe and regulated by MAS?</div><div fs-accordion-element=\"arrow\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_arrow-wrapper syfe--is-active-accordion\"><div fs-accordion-line=\"vertical\" class=\"syfe--fs_accordion-2_vertical-line\"></div><div
